findings.issue: Corrupt saved manifest with persisted installing phase could leave invisible cancelled status and inhibit future checks

findings.issue: Legacy APK uses an external-browser confirmation dialog before downloading, so notification-only instruction skips a step
findings.resolution: Sent to web agent for wording correction.

findings.issue: Downloaded and queued data are retained, but unsaved React input cannot be promised to survive actual APK process replacement
findings.resolution: Sent to root/web agent; UI should ask to save open entries before installing. Test fixture only checks no clearing during update events, never actual OS replacement.
